project.title: Merit Office Campus
project.intro: A contemporary workplace designed around the idea that the best offices feel like great homes — calm, considered, and full of natural materials. The brief was to move away from the open-plan monotony common to tech companies.
project.challenge: Balancing the need for collaborative zones with the psychological need for focus, privacy, and calm in a high-output creative environment.
project.response: The floor was zoned into distinct neighbourhoods — each with its own material character, lighting level, and acoustic treatment. A central pantry-library became the social heart of the campus.

nextProject.title: The Pali Residence
nextProject.intro: A 3,200 sq ft family residence in the heart of Pali Hill, reimagined as a calm, layered interior that balances warmth with restraint. Every material was chosen for its tactile quality and its ability to age gracefully.
nextProject.challenge: The existing layout fragmented the social spaces into disconnected rooms, and the large windows — while flooding the apartment with light — had no cohesive response in the material palette.
nextProject.response: We opened the living, dining, and kitchen into a single continuous plane, anchored by a long limestone island and a full-height bookwall. The window frames were treated as architectural moments, each with a deep sill and woven roman blind.
